question: Jinbe-san!! Congratulations on officially joining the Straw Hat Pirates! I was waiting for you!! Please tell us all the detailed character info for him that was given in the previous SBSes for the other 9 crew members!! –
answer: Sure. The letter also included all that I need to answer. It's all the details I've given about Luffy and the others up until now. His favorite foods was already revealed in One Piece's Vivre Card databook are mozuku seaweed in vinegar and fruits. Beyond those, here's the rest: #Least Favorite Food: Parfait (because it's hard to eat) #Associated color and number: Ochre, 10 #Position in the crew if they were a family: Father (so far Franky was the father, but he's now been relegated to be the pervy granny, which Jinbe is officially the father) #Smell: Smells like sea #Associated Prefecture: Kagoshima #Associated Country: India #Associated Animal: Bear #Cooking Specialty: Bonito Tataki (Japanese fish dish) #Sleep and Wake Up Time: from 3AM to 9AM #What goes on in his brain: → #Profession if he wasn't a pirate: Train station attendant #Does he chew or swallow ice: Swallows #Favorite Season: Autumn on a summer island #Associated Flower: Peony
name: Yashirai
